description: Renovate preset of every lernapps repo: extends: ["github>lernapps/tooling"]

packageRules.description: Our own building blocks (the site frame from lernapps.github.io, the actions in tooling) follow main at once, at any time of the week, and merge when green: they are git commits without a release date, and a change to them is meant to reach every site
vite-plus and the Vite core it bundles move together: package.json overrides vite with npm:@voidzero-dev/vite-plus-core at the same version as vite-plus
